trust.title: Trust in the Supreme Court, 2003–2025
trust.question: Trust in the Supreme Court: share answering "very much" or "quite a lot"
trust.source: Israel Democracy Institute, Israeli Democracy Index 2025 (Appendix 2)
trust.note: Selected years from IDI's annual series. Annual Democracy Index surveys, fieldwork usually in May; the 2025 survey is the latest (the 2026 index is expected in December). IDI's own label is "Arabs", and its Arab sample includes Druze; that sample is small (about ±5.1%) and swings widely from year to year. IDI also published a December 2023 reading from a different survey, the Israeli Voice Index; it is not part of this series and is not shown.

trust-groups.title: Trust in the Supreme Court among Jews, by group
trust-groups.question: Trust in the Supreme Court: share answering "very much" or "quite a lot", Jewish respondents
trust-groups.source: Israel Democracy Institute, Israeli Democracy Index 2025 (Table 2.6, Figure 2.7) and 2024 (Table 2.11)
trust-groups.note: Annual Democracy Index surveys; the 2023 column is the June 2023 survey. Political camp is self-identified. The 2023 and 2024 camp figures are from the 2024 index (https://en.idi.org.il/media/27509/israel-democracy-index-2024-e_for_web_17-2-2025.pdf). December 2023 readings from the separate Israeli Voice Index are not shown. No 2026 breakdown by group has been published.
